contracts.name: AaveV4CreditAdapter
contracts.notice: AaveV4CreditAdapter — one Aave V4 spoke position owned by one MandateVault. The adapter is the Aave user: it holds the collateral and the debt, and only its vault can move them. Everything withdrawn or borrowed goes straight to the vault. borrow() and withdraw() re-read the health factor after the action and revert below the vault's minimum, so the minimum holds even if a projection was off.

functions.name: hub
functions.notice: Holds every supplied collateral token; the spoke pulls supplies into it and it sends withdrawals out.

functions.name: projectedHealthFactorAfterBorrow
functions.notice: HF = collateral value x avgCF / debt value, with the new debt valued at the spoke oracle's USDC price. Matched Aave's own post-borrow HF on a Base fork. Existing debt is rounded up.

errors.name: HealthFactorTooLow
errors.notice: Raised by borrow/withdraw when the health factor after the action is below the minimum.

contracts.name: AerodromeSwapAdapter
contracts.notice: Exact-input swaps directly against an Aerodrome Slipstream pool (no router).

contracts.name: ICreditAdapter
contracts.notice: One lending position owned by one MandateVault. Stock amounts are raw units, USDC has 6 decimals, health factors are WAD (1e18 = 1.00; type(uint256).max with no debt). be bound to the vault). Mutations are low-level calls whose return data is ignored, so neither a revert nor malformed return data can revert the vault's execute().

functions.name: borrow
functions.notice: Borrows USDC to the vault. Reverts HealthFactorTooLow if HF ends below `minHealthFactor`.

functions.name: collateralCustodian
functions.notice: Holds supplied `token` and sends it out on withdraw (B20 sender / receiver / executor legs).

functions.name: collateralOperator
functions.notice: Pulls supplied tokens from the adapter (B20 executor leg).

functions.name: hasPosition
functions.notice: True while any debt or supplied collateral remains; the vault refuses to switch adapters then.

functions.name: repay
functions.notice: Pulls min(amount, debt) USDC from the vault (approve `amount` first) and repays it.

functions.name: suppliedOf
functions.notice: Returns 0 (never reverts) for tokens the adapter does not support; the vault reads it for every listed token.

functions.name: supply
functions.notice: Pulls `amount` of `token` from the vault (approve first), supplies it and enables it as collateral.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.notice: Withdraws collateral to the vault. Reverts HealthFactorTooLow if HF ends below `minHealthFactor`.

errors.name: HealthFactorTooLow
errors.notice: Raised by borrow/withdraw when the health factor after the action is below the minimum.

functions.name: swapExactIn
functions.notice: Pulls `amountIn` of `tokenIn` from msg.sender, swaps it in `pool`, sends the output and any unused input to `recipient`. Reverts if the output is below `minOut`.

contracts.name: MandateVault
contracts.notice: MandateVault — "LLM proposes, contract decides." Holds an agent's USDC + tokenized-stock treasury. The executor submits intents; the vault applies the mandate and market guards and records every verdict, including refusals, as a Decision event.

functions.name: fund
functions.notice: Owner capital injection. Pulls USDC from the owner (approve first) and records it so it is not reported as revenue by notifyRevenue(). Revenue that was already pending stays pending.

functions.name: GRACE_PERIOD
functions.notice: A queued change must be applied within this window after its eta, or it expires.

functions.name: policyHash
functions.notice: Commitment to the whole policy: keccak256(abi.encode(mandate, tokens, configs, payees)), where configs[i] = tokenConfig[tokens[i]] (tokens in listing order, delisted ones included) and payees is the current allowlist in payees() order. Emitted as PolicyHashUpdated on construction and every apply.

functions.name: previewIntent
functions.notice: Same verdict execute() would reach before acting. Cannot predict SWAP_FAILED / TRANSFER_FAILED / CREDIT_FAILED, nor the adapter's own post-action health check on WITHDRAW_COLLATERAL against debt.

functions.name: queueMandate
functions.notice: Timelocked changes are queued with their full parameters (emitted in the event) and can be applied with exactly those parameters between eta = queuedAt + TIMELOCK and eta + GRACE_PERIOD.

contracts.name: MarketCalendar
contracts.notice: US equity session calendar in America/New_York time. The owner can only make it stricter; loosening means deploying a new calendar through the vault timelock.

structs.name: Intent
structs.notice: BUY: amount = USDC in (6 decimals). SELL / SUPPLY / WITHDRAW_COLLATERAL: token = stock, amount = raw stock amount. BORROW / REPAY: token = USDC, amount = USDC. PAY_EXPENSE: USDC to `payee`.

structs.name: Mandate
structs.notice: USD amounts are USDC units (6 decimals).
